page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with two marginal notes in the left margin ("Fortitudo.", "Temperantia."). Running head at top, page number at top left, catchword "Idéa" at the lower right.

main_text.p: XXVIII. Hæc autem tanto plus officii tribuit, quanto quis conjunctior fuerit.
XXIX. Sic inprimis conjugi tùm liberis, tum parentibus, tum civibus, tum patriæ; deniq; cuivis ho-mini, quamvis ignoto.
XXX. Deinde alia virtus est tùm Fortitudo, tùm modestia.
XXXI. Fortitudo res omnes forti & præ-senti animo gerit.Fortitudo.
XXXII. Proinde ita Rempubl. & rem privatam tuetur, tùm pacis, tùm belli tempore.
XXXIII. Modestia, modum & decorum in omnibus tenet: Quæ proprie Temperantia in voluptatibus moderandis. Et hinc boni mores dicun-tur.Temperan-tia.
XXXIV. Quæ propria etiam personarum officia tradit, ut senum, juvenum; item magistratuum & privatorum, &c.
XXXV. Atq; ita simpliciter officium sequitur id, quod honestum.
XXXVI. Deinde comparatè, quod honestius, aut honestissimum sequitur.

p.i: Sic honestius est ea, quæ prudenter aliquis cogitaverit, agere; quàm in cogitatione illâ acquiescere. Itaq; justitia anteponitur prudentiæ.
Hinc studia nostra ad Rempublicam deniq; conferenda.

page.notes: Printed text is clear throughout. Hyphenated line breaks are kept as printed ("præ-senti", "ho-mini", "dicun-tur", "Temperan-tia"). Long s is transcribed as s, and the printed "eft" is read as "est". The italic/roman boundaries inside XXXIII and XXXV are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The catchword "Idéa" is given as printed.
